reasoning: The icon depicts a page or SIM-shaped card with a clipped corner and a bold dollar sign inside. It strongly cues tasks involving invoices, utility bills, tax forms, quotes, or prepaid mobile top-ups, which are very frequent in personal and work task lists. Because the cut corner lacks an interior fold line, it straddles the visual boundary between a document file and a SIM card.
